commands.cmd: Browser walkthrough on a temporary vault: folder selection -> 9 candidates -> approve -> search -> source citation

goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Delivered the first real product slice. `npm start` launches a polished localhost-only web application. Browser directory import supports bounded Markdown/TXT capture, immutable vault snapshots, secret-like warnings, deterministic line-cited candidates, edit/approve/reject review, canonical memory files, local approved-memory search, openable source views, deduplication, changed-source invalidation and restart persistence. The complete suite now passes 35 tests; global specs, release readiness, secret hygiene and diff checks remain green. The browser walkthrough succeeded on a temporary vault.
